description: Override a location's policy (partial update: transferable, maxTransfers, defaultValidityMinutes, verificationRequirement, holderCancellable, maxActiveTokens, enforceTimeWindow, requireVerifyBeforeUse, approachingThreshold). Set reset=true to restore the industry preset. Requires the RIGHTOS_API_KEY environment variable (operator API key).

approachingThreshold.description: queue.approaching webhook threshold: notify the organization's webhooks once per token when aheadCount drops below this after a slot frees up; null = disabled

holderCancellable.description: Whether the current holder can self-cancel the token

maxActiveTokens.description: Max concurrent active queue tokens; null = unlimited

reset.description: true = reset to the industry preset (ignores other fields)

name: set_location_policy
